mission: To create qualified sales opportunities by rapidly responding to inbound demand and executing targeted outbound outreach, ensuring the Closer consistently receives qualified prospects who show up prepared for the sales conversation.
capacity: All activity logged in HubSpot within 24 hours, every week; next step and date documented on every active lead. Flag Grant and Savannah in advance if lead volume or pipeline health puts the monthly meeting target at risk.

kpis.name: 1. Qualified Showed Meetings
kpis.calculation: Number of qualified prospects who actually attend the scheduled sales meeting

kpis.name: 2. Closer Acceptance Rate
kpis.calculation: Showed meetings accepted by the Closer as meeting qualification criteria ÷ total showed meetings

kpis.name: 3. Show Rate
kpis.calculation: Prospects who attend ÷ total qualified meetings booked

kpis.name: 4. Inbound Speed-to-Lead
kpis.calculation: Inbound leads receiving first response within 10 minutes during working hours ÷ total inbound leads received during working hours

kpis.name: 5. Handoff Completeness
kpis.calculation: Qualified meetings with required research, discovery context, qualification data, and CRM notes completed before the sales call ÷ total qualified meetings

outcomes.howMeasured: ≥44 qualified sales meetings show per month
≥80% of showed meetings are accepted by the Closer as meeting the defined qualification criteria
No-show rate ≤15% through confirmations, reminders, and follow-up
≥95% of inbound leads receive first response within 10 minutes during working hours; remaining leads contacted within 2 business hours
100% of booked meetings include required ICP and qualification information: company, stakeholder, need/pain, and relevant context
100% of qualified meetings have discovery context, relevant notes, and required CRM information completed before the Closer meeting
100% of activities logged within 24h; next step and date documented on every active lead owned by Setter

values.label: Build-Sharpen-Scale.
values.body: Turns winning outreach, qualification questions, and follow-up sequences into repeatable templates and processes.

values.label: Passion for Modern Solutions.
values.body: Uses AI, automation, and modern prospecting tools when they improve response rates, qualification, or efficiency.

values.label: Empathetic Ownership.
values.body: Owns the quality of the meeting, not simply whether something appears on the calendar.

values.label: Be Decent, Be Direct.
values.body: Communicates clearly with prospects, qualifies honestly, and does not force poor-fit leads into the sales process.
